n: LLMs Unplugged Sampling and Beam Search modules
t: Two paper modules on how a model picks words and why the likeliest sentence can disappoint.
steps: Find the LLMs Unplugged site and open the modules page.
Run the Training and Generation modules first.
Open the Sampling module page and the Beam Search module page.
Print the sheets or cutouts from the site.
Gather pens, paper, and dice. Use a d10 for the grid activities.
Plan 20 to 30 minutes for Sampling and 30 to 40 for Beam Search.
Check the content license stated on the site.
